frozen using: Development subset only: 200 documents. Alias decisions recorded in alias decisions.csv.

system b.description: Matches canonical forms and accepted aliases. Every match returns the canonical label.

normalisation policy.apostrophe_normalisation: Curly apostrophes are converted to straight apostrophes.
normalisation policy.dash normalisation: En dashes and em dashes are converted to ASCII hyphens.
normalisation policy.whitespace: Repeated whitespace is collapsed to one space.
normalisation policy.ordinary hyphens: Preserved; ordinary hyphens are not converted to spaces.

boundary policy.internal_spaces: One or more whitespace characters may represent a space inside a multiword form.
boundary policy.hyphen policy: A candidate directly joined to a hyphen is blocked. Therefore ML-based and NLP-based do not match under the conservative baseline policy.

rejected or redundant_forms.power-bi: Rejected as an explicit alias because it had zero development-document matches.
rejected or redundant_forms.pbi: Rejected because it had zero development-document matches.
rejected or redundant_forms.microsoft power bi: Redundant because canonical power bi already appears inside the longer phrase.
